limitations: Available liquidity and caps are current state, not timeless vault guarantees.

dimensions.meaning: idle mUSDC plus adapter realAssets after the vault's bounded accrual rule
mUSDC value of the adapter's Morpho supply shares; not a second asset balance
mUSDC currently transferable from Morpho; constrains ordinary withdrawal/deallocation
market liability owned by protocols/lending/musdc, not a vault depositor position
separate penalty path; must not be represented as an ordinary guaranteed withdrawal

allocationRule: Deposits allocate to liquidityAdapter; withdrawals use idle assets first and then request exact shortfall deallocation.
configurationRules: Read the complete adapter queue and each adapter-returned allocation ID before evaluating caps; one adapter position can contribute to multiple cap dimensions.
Resolve all four gate addresses at the quote block; the zero address disables that gate only at that coordinate.
Resolve selector-specific timelock and abdication state for every curator operation; decreaseTimelock uses the target selector's duration rather than its own mapping entry.
Allocator and sentinel mappings are not enumerable from getters; reconstruct membership from bounded events and confirm candidates with direct reads before any operation support.
reconciliationRule: Vault assets include adapter value once; do not add the same Morpho supply assets again.
